title: Rolling scope contracts + weekly skill-pool allocator for cycle microbalancing
creator: Asha Gupta
description: Goal: Introduce a lightweight operational pattern that (1) enforces a minimal committed scope contract for each initiative and (2) provides a weekly skill-pool allocator to rebalance available engineering capacity across parallel tracks. This is intended to reduce mid-cycle firefighting, make scope cuts explicit and fast, and increase the probability that high-ROI slices land on schedule. Deliverables: a short runbook (confluence) for PMs/Eng leads, a one-page checklist for scope-contract negotiation, an automated weekly spreadsheet that surfaces skill gaps and cross-team availability, and a pilot across 2 initiatives in the next cycle. Key tradeoffs considered: administrative overhead vs. reduced rework, risk of frequent reassignments impacting deep work, and potential morale impact from week-to-week rotation. The runbook will include guardrails (max 20% weekly reassignments per engineer, no more than 2 consecutive weeks in a non-primary squad) and an escalation path to the product operations lead.
